review_candidates.description: About The Company Searchability is a specialist recruitment company focused on connecting skilled technology professionals with organizations seeking expertise across software engineering, cloud computing, digital transformation, data, and IT infrastructure. The company supports recruitment across a range of technical disciplines, helping businesses and public sector organizations identify professionals with the skills required to deliver complex technology initiatives. For this opportunity, Searchability is recruiting a Contract Platform / DevOps Engineer to support major UK Government digital projects. The position focuses on building secure, scalable, and resilient cloud infrastructure while helping engineering teams improve automation, deployment processes, and operational reliability. The opportunity offers experienced DevOps professionals the chance to contribute to important digital services within a government technology environment. The role emphasizes cloud infrastructure engineering, infrastructure as code, continuous integration and delivery, security, and operational excellence. About The Role Searchability is seeking an experienced Contract Platform / DevOps Engineer – AWS to join an established engineering team supporting major UK Government digital projects. This fully remote contract role is designed for a cloud and infrastructure professional with strong hands-on experience in Amazon Web Services (AWS), Terraform, automation, and modern DevOps practices. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining, and optimizing cloud infrastructure that supports secure and highly available digital services. Working closely with software developers, platform engineers, security specialists, and other technical stakeholders, you will help automate infrastructure provisioning, improve CI/CD pipelines, and establish reliable deployment processes. The position requires a strong understanding of cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational resilience. You will also contribute to the development of repeatable infrastructure patterns and engineering standards that improve consistency, scalability, and security across environments. As part of a knowledgeable technical team, you will help identify opportunities to streamline infrastructure management, reduce manual intervention, and improve the performance and reliability of production systems. The engagement is expected to run for 12 months, with a day rate of £550 inside IR35. The role is fully remote and offers the opportunity to contribute to substantial public sector digital initiatives. Key Responsibilities AWS Infrastructure Engineering: Design, deploy, configure, and maintain secure and scalable cloud infrastructure using AWS services and established cloud engineering practices. Infrastructure as Code: Develop and maintain Terraform configurations and reusable modules to automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management. CI/CD Automation: Build, maintain, and optimize continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines to support reliable application releases and infrastructure changes. Platform Engineering: Develop reusable platform components, automation tools, and infrastructure patterns that enable development teams to deploy and operate applications efficiently. Cloud Security: Implement security best practices across cloud environments, including identity and access management, network security, encryption, and secure configuration. High Availability and Resilience: Design and maintain resilient infrastructure that supports service availability, fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and business continuity requirements. Monitoring and Observability: Configure and improve monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability solutions to identify issues and maintain operational visibility. Troubleshooting and Incident Response: Investigate infrastructure failures, deployment issues, performance bottlenecks, and production incidents, implementing effective corrective actions. Automation and Scripting: Develop scripts and automation solutions using suitable programming or scripting languages to reduce repetitive operational tasks. Open-Source Tooling: Evaluate and use relevant open-source tools to improve infrastructure management, deployment automation, monitoring, and platform operations. Collaboration: Work closely with developers, architects, security teams, and other stakeholders to translate technical requirements into reliable infrastructure solutions. Performance and Cost Optimization: Assess cloud resource utilization, identify inefficiencies, and implement improvements that balance performance, availability, and cost. Documentation and Standards: Maintain clear technical documentation, infrastructure diagrams, deployment procedures, and operational runbooks. Continuous Improvement: Contribute to DevOps best practices, infrastructure standardization, automation initiatives, and ongoing improvements to engineering workflows. Required Qualifications And Experience Demonstrable professional experience as a DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineer, Cloud Engineer, or Infrastructure Engineer. Strong hands-on experience designing, deploying, and managing infrastructure on Amazon Web Services (AWS). Practical experience using Terraform for infrastructure as code, including reusable configurations and infrastructure lifecycle management. Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for application deployment and infrastructure changes. Strong understanding of Linux systems administration, networking fundamentals, and cloud infrastructure architecture. Familiarity with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or comparable pipeline technologies. Experience implementing disaster recovery strategies, infrastructure monitoring, and automated recovery mechanisms. Awareness of public sector security requirements and secure cloud delivery practices. Experience supporting UK Government or other regulated environments may be beneficial, particularly where security, auditability, and operational resilience are important.
